verdict.rationale: Clerky documents that it logs every change anyone makes to a document set or workspace, showing who was responsible for what, and document sets bundle the signatures that users complete on Clerky. That is a first-party audit-trail capability, but only a thin one for this story. Missing for 10: any evidence the audit trail is tamper-evident, any completion certificate for signed documents, detail on what signing events are captured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
